comparison.objective: Fit a window restrictor, versus fracture and recovery of four threaded-insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Restrictor alignment and attachment, not mandrel stabilization, hammer impact regulation, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: A fitted restrictor is implied, but attachment tolerances and damage criteria are absent. Candidate requires four verified fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Both may involve alignment, but their central tested transformations—installing a restrictor versus breaking notched tangs—differ materially.
